message.content:
A magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large, black, sans-serif letters displays a vertical red border on the left. At the top, "GERILYA DANA" and "RIO HARYANTO" frame a circular portrait of a person in white racing gear. Centered, a pair of hands holds a square wooden frame containing a sliding tile puzzle. The puzzle pieces form a fragmented illustration of a human face in profile. One tile is missing, and a finger is positioned over a gray tile as if to slide it. The illustration on the tiles shows a person with short dark hair, light-colored skin, and a blue shirt collar.

The text "14-20 MARET 2016" appears below the magazine title. Large black text reads "SAATNYA DEG-DEGAN." Below, smaller text says: "Presiden Jokowi bersiap kembali merombak kabinetnya. Gaduh dan berkinerja buruk jadi acuan. Posisi Sudirman Said dan Rizal Ramli di ujung tanduk." A barcode, price "RP 39.500," and "www.tempo.co" are in the bottom left corner. A stylized yellow, red, and brown logo is on the left.
